findings.text: follow-on: the third latched-memory branch's body (recovery.py:8283-8288) is not reached by any of the three new tests and cannot be reached by reading, because every run whose memory reads promoted already continues in the departures loop (recovery.py:8222) or the state-change loop (recovery.py:8246), so no change carrying that run is appended for the final loop to hold; the guard is therefore harmless redundant code, not a working protection, and a future reader should not read it as load-bearing.
